title: Take It, Leave It, or Fix It: Measuring Productivity and Trust in Human-Al Collaboration

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative analysis of user performance and answer-changing behaviors, specifically observing how users substitute effort and inappropriately switch from correct to incorrect answers when given access to a conversational AI agent.

Qualitative thematic analysis of user think-aloud transcripts and prompts, identifying instances where users asked leading questions to seek validation and agreement for their pre-selected answers from the AI.
